source_refs.note: Y-linked Traits: a main subheading of 18.8.1 Sex-linked Traits in Humans, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 108-108.

blocks.text: Y chromosome par X ke muqable mein kaafi kam genes hain, isi liye Y-linked khasiyatein kam milti hain. Y-linked genes ke alleles X chromosome par nahi hote. Aise genes holandric genes (ya hemizygous genes) kehlate hain aur sirf Y chromosome ke non-homologous hisse par hote hain. Y-linked khasiyatein sirf mardon mein aati hain aur sirf baap se bete ko jati hain. Kitab ki misalein: hypertrichosis (kaan ke kinare par baal), porcupine man (jism par seedhe sakht baal) aur paon ki ungliyon ka aapas mein jura hona (webbing of toes).

blocks.alt: Insani shaklein. Non-carrier maa XX aur khasiyat wala baap XYr. Eggs X aur X; sperm X aur Yr. Lakeerein chaar bachchon tak: do betiyan XX (non-carrier) aur do bete XYr (khasiyat maujood). Key: r Y-linked allele.

blocks.prompt: Rang-andha (colour-blind) mard aisi aurat se shadi karta hai jo carrier nahi. Beton aur betiyon ke baare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Beton ko maa ka normal X milta hai, is liye koi beta rang-andha nahi hoga. Har beti ko baap ka X milta hai, is liye sab betiyan normal nazar wali carriers hongi.

items: X-linked recessive: mardon mein zyada; carrier maa ke 50% bete mutasir; mutasir baap ki sab betiyan carrier.
X-linked dominant: auraton mein zyada; mutasir baap sab betiyon ko deta hai, beton ko nahi.
Y-linked (holandric) genes: sirf mardon mein, baap se har bete ko.
